images.title: Parallel opposite sides, no right angle
images.purpose: Shows parallelogram ABCD with AB = 4 cm, AD = 5 cm and a 30° angle: opposite sides parallel, yet not a rectangle.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large slanting parallelogram in the centre with parallel marks and its two given sides and angle labelled.
images.exact_structure: One parallelogram ABCD in dark outline: AB is the horizontal bottom side, A at bottom left and B at bottom right; AD leans to the right at 30° above AB and is a little longer than AB (5 to 4); D is top left and C top right. AB and DC each carry one teal (#0072B2) arrowhead pointing right, showing they are parallel; AD and BC each carry two amber (#E69F00) arrowheads, showing they are parallel. A small reddish purple (#CC79A7) arc at A is labelled 30°. The label 4 cm sits under AB and the label 5 cm sits left of AD. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A quadrilateral with both pairs of opposite sides parallel is a parallelogram, and it need not be a rectangle.
images.description: Shows parallelogram ABCD with AB = 4 cm, AD = 5 cm and a 30° angle: opposite sides parallel, yet not a rectangle.
images.context: Construction: AB = 4 cm, ∠A = 30°, AD = 5 cm, lines through D and B parallel to AB and AD meet at C.

image_decisions.why: A clearly slanted parallelogram with its parallel marks shows the new family that is not a rectangle.
